exposure: conception spontaneously or through non-IVF fertility treatments
outcome: composite severe neonatal morbidity (respiratory distress syndrome, necrotizing enterocolitis, severe intraventricular hemorrhage, retinopathy of prematurity, neonatal sepsis, or death)
cohort: The study included 82 women who delivered a triplet gestation at >=24 weeks at a large academic center between 2005 and 2016.
finding: There was no significant difference in composite neonatal morbidity or other neonatal outcomes between triplet gestations conceived via IVF and those conceived spontaneously or through non-IVF fertility treatments.
